newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares turn negative on EMU worries.
newsitem.headline: French shares turn negative on EMU worries.

text.p: French shares turned opening gains into slight losses as investors became wary about the Luxembourg finance ministers' meeting. "There is no fundamental news in the market. We started up but now the volumes are kicking in and people are a bit nervous about EMU," a dealer said.
* CAC-40 index down 5.62, or 0.21 percent, at 2,713.63 at 0938 GMT
* CAC-40 June futures 2,701 vs 2,700 at Friday's close.
